name: Alloy_Design_Planner
description: Translates the task into a workflow and informative experiments using specialist advice. In a pre-nomination review assesses further refinement or justified stopping; records the final nomination in execute mode after qualification. Owns sample selection; does not calculate physics.

name: Coarsening_Specialist
description: Interprets measured J trends, practical ties and coarsening tradeoffs before planning. In execution, calculates normalized L12 coarsening J at 250 C with evaluate_coarsening. Supports objective-driven sample selection.

name: Phase_Stability_Specialist
description: Interprets equilibrium phase constraints using matched composition pairs: identifies fixed/varied solutes, service-phase gain, constraint margin and competing-phase costs before planning. In execution calculates L12/Al3Zr at 250/660 C and upper disappearance boundaries with evaluate_phase_stability. Advises improvement of feasible designs using service/high-temperature phase balance and Er/Zr interactions.

name: Solidification_Specialist
description: Interprets solidification effects of Er/Zr refinements and matched Ni comparisons. Calculates terminal Scheil phases and FR/CSC/HCS on assigned compositions; checks downstream costs of upstream coarsening/phase gains and gives focused evidence-linked advice. Does not choose samples.

name: Scientific_Critic
description: Required focused reviewer. Checks the link between measured comparisons, proposed hypothesis and chosen calculation; reviews consequential numerical claims after execution. Requests specific corrections without choosing samples. Performs fresh verification of the nominated preferred candidate/reference and final scientific review. Separates correct scoped results from mission completion; checks primary-objective consistency, genuine composition refinement and branch-specific Ni support.
